long_biography.plain_text:
Lucio Presta entered Italian television as a dancer, performing in five editions of the variety show Fantastico before moving behind the scenes. He first organised a theatrical tour, then developed artist-management and production work. In 2002 he established Arcobaleno Tre in Rome, creating a business around talent representation, television production and major live events.

Presta continues to guide Arcobaleno Tre's agency activity and to work as an agent and producer, but he no longer owns its shares. His children Niccolò and Beatrice each hold 40 percent; the remaining shares belong equally to Giulia and Riccardo Carnevale, his wife Paola Perego's children. Perego's broadcasting career and personal assets remain separate from Presta's founder and operating record.
